versions.changelog:
OpenClaw Web Chat Pro 1.0.0

- Initial release of a production-grade AI web chat application.
- Supports basic chat (free), multi-model switching, streaming output, conversation persistence, chat export, and dark mode.
- Pro features (subscription) include file uploads, voice input/output, multi-device sync, team collaboration, and advanced analytics.
- Enterprise features (subscription) include private deployment, custom models, SSO login, audit logs, and SLA guarantee.
- Provides configurable environment variables and simple API endpoints for chat, model listing, and health checks.
